verdict.rationale: Okta can be automated programmatically rather than through a UI. The evidence shows Admin Management APIs exposed through an official open-source MCP server, event hooks that make outbound HTTPS calls, SCIM's RESTful CRUD API, documented API rate limits, and an Integrator plan marketed for 'manage and automate Okta'. However, nothing explicitly covers running headlessly in CI pipelines, an official CLI, or non-interactive service credentials. missing for 10: official CLI or CI/CD integration docs, headless service-account/machine auth guidance, infrastructure-as-code tooling, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
